_what: Find anything (src/workspace/command-palette.tsx, the ported palette in parts/command-palette): the screen it is (its screen row's `surface_id`, whose open_placement floats it in the middle over a dimmed, blurred backdrop), the keys that open and close it from anywhere (the `find-anything` rows of src/workspace/keymap.json, the one keymap), and where results come from. Each `sources` row is one place results are read: `read` names the reader (`screens`: every screen this person is offered, as the sidebar holds them; `mentions`: everything `@` offers from src/mention-sources.json, with kinds named by `typed_kinds` asked again as words are typed; `calendar`: the person's events from now through `calendar.look_ahead_days` (GET /work/api/calendar), each under the heading of the `calendar.buckets` row its day falls in, with its time as its words; `search`: src/search.mjs, the indexed word search used by the MCP `search` tool, with `ask` naming its `sources` and `matches` options), `group` the heading its results show under (a mention takes its kind's own label when `group` is left out; a `calendar` event takes its bucket's label), `blank` whether it fills the palette before anything is typed, and `limit` how many it gives at most. Each `actions` row is offered under the results once anything is typed: `run` names what it does (`message-box`: opens the message box with the words, to send to your AIs or the ones you @mention; `send-to-all-ais`: sends the words to every AI now, as one job one of them takes), `title` and `description` its words with {query} the words typed, `done` what is said once it was sent. The other places a result can open, offered on its hover card, are the shared open choices (parts/ui/show/placeable-surface-intent/open-choices.json).

actions.title: Ask your AIs: “{query}”
actions.description: Opens the message box with this, to send to every AI or the ones you @mention.

actions.title: I need this: “{query}”
actions.description: Hands it to your AIs now; one of them takes it and works it out.
actions.done: Sent to your AIs. One of them takes it.

calendar._what: The Calendar source's DATA: events are read from the start of today for `look_ahead_days` days; a `buckets` row names the heading (`label`) of the events on its day: `day` is the number of days from today it holds alone, `from_day` the first of the days it holds from there on. An event's words are its time (`all_day` for a whole day) and then its place when it has one.
